findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State that `resolve_cli` must change to `(argv, tracker, repo_root)` to match the flipped `argv_tracker_root` adapter and host the folded `--display` mode resolution.
evidence: Code `_execute.py:114-122`: `argv_tracker_root` calls `fn(rest, tracker, None)` — a 3-arg handler contract
Code `lookups.py:94`: `def resolve_cli(argv: list[str], tracker: str) -> int:` — 2-arg
Code `lookups.py:110,120`: `format_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)` uses `_display_mode(repo_root)`, which is why `resolve` must become argv_tracker_root to host `--display`
The plan names the adapter flip and the fold but not the required `resolve_cli` signature change
findings.finding: Flipping `resolve` to the `argv_tracker_root` adapter (to host the folded `--display` mode logic, which needs repo_root) requires changing `resolve_cli`'s signature from `(argv, tracker)` to `(argv, tracker, repo_root)`; the plan does not state this, so the adapter would call a 2-arg handler with 3 args.
findings.location: Approach step (2) "flip `resolve` to `argv_tracker_root`" and step (3) "`format` folded into `resolve --display[=MODE]`"
scenarios: Implementer flips the adapter per the plan but leaves `resolve_cli` 2-arg → `TypeError: resolve_cli() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given` at dispatch
findings.suggested_fix: Add to step 3: "widen `resolve_cli(argv, tracker)` to `resolve_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)` and move `format_cli`'s `_display_mode(repo_root)` resolution into it under `--display[=MODE]`."
